behavior: A shared request-owned guard captures connected TCP and completed TLS streams through the documented HTTPX trace extension before response headers exist.
Slow/incomplete headers cannot refresh the total request budget. Cancellation interrupts that connection; separate concurrent requests stay intact.
One guard covers headers and body; shutdown precedes close, including streams not yet owned by the connection pool. Cleanup ignores its own response-close trace and releases watchdogs.
Five HTTP providers preserve cancellation precedence, sanitized errors, no hidden retry and response-size limits. Three HTTPS-capable providers also pass real post-handshake TLS header interruption.
Durable evaluation saves CANCELLED or BLOCKED/AI_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT, makes one request, persists no partial evaluation, and reads the same state through fresh Store/API.

diagnostic_history: Initial revised cleanup tests exposed deadline checks raising before explicit shutdown; guard now interrupts before raising and closes streams independently of pool ownership.

Tiny body-read tests could expire during HTTPX client/SSL-context construction without opening a socket. Read-boundary oracles now precreate clients and assert response headers were reached; a separate test proves expired client initialization sends no request.
Windows peer disconnect can be ConnectionAbortedError as well as EOF/reset. Tests now recognize that specific terminal socket outcome.

TLS cases initially included HTTP-only Ollama/Local Endpoint and were rejected by configuration policy; TLS proof is correctly limited to the three HTTPS-capable providers. No production TLS policy was weakened.

reviews.findings: No blocking issue after cleanup fixes; TLS establishment limitation retained.

references.use: Documented trace and network_stream contracts; httpx0.28.1/httpcore1.0.9 pinned in requirements.txt.

limitations: DNS/TCP connection and stalled TLS establishment before stream exposure retain HTTPX phase timeouts; prompt cancellation and a combined total establishment deadline are NOT_VERIFIED.
Custom transports can omit trace/socket metadata; arbitrary custom I/O interruption is not certified.
Synthetic loopback fixtures only; no paid inference or external job submission.
Parent spans many other external operation classes and remains PARTIAL.
